name: TRMNL proxy
description: Render the next-up screen from your TRMNL account on a Tesserae cell. Paste a device API key; Tesserae steps your playlist like the TRMNL firmware would, or mirrors what your TRMNL device shows. The token never leaves the host, which proxies the image bytes itself.

settings.name: access_token
settings.label: Device API key
settings.help: From your TRMNL dashboard: Devices → click the device → Edit → 'Device API Key'.

settings.name: mode
settings.label: Mode

choices.label: Advance my playlist (my TRMNL device points at Tesserae)
Mirror my TRMNL device (it still polls TRMNL's servers)

settings.help: Advance uses /api/display, the call the TRMNL firmware makes, so each refresh moves to the next playlist item. Pick Mirror only if a real TRMNL device still polls usetrmnl.com and this cell should copy it; nothing advances the playlist in that mode except that device.

settings.name: base_url
settings.label: Server URL
settings.help: Leave as https://usetrmnl.com for a TRMNL account. To use a self-hosted LaraPaper or other BYOS server, enter its address (e.g. http://192.168.1.20:4567) and paste that server's device API key above. The image links that server returns must also be reachable from Tesserae, so set LaraPaper's APP_URL to an address Tesserae can open.
